title: Insider says 10 people have the bigger picture and the intent is a little scary
plain: An insider is said to have claimed that only ten people know the bigger picture behind what is being kept secret, and that the intent behind it is a little scary. James Fox, who investigates UFO cases, tells Michels this second-hand, passing on what he heard through the journalist Leslie Kean. If true, it would mean the full story rests with a very small circle, and that their aims are troubling.
